title: Lifting one computation step
statement: Let $\Gamma$ have decidable equality, let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, and let $e:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\hookrightarrow\Gamma$ be an embedding. For every Boolean input word $x$ and configuration $c$ of $M$ on $x$, one step of the lifted machine from the lifted configuration equals the lift of the configuration obtained by taking one step of $M$ from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding of Boolean symbols into $\Gamma$
